title: Cloaked Figures in Psychedelic Ritual
description: Five hooded figures in black robes stand in a row with their heads replaced by dripping black voids, red liquid flowing down their fronts. The surreal landscape features floating disembodied female faces with similar dripping effects, colorful spirals, glowing orbs, and psychedelic patterns against a dramatic mountain range at sunset.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic scene with five hooded black-robed figures standing in a row, their heads replaced by dripping black voids with red liquid flowing down their robes. Floating disembodied female faces with dripping effects hover above, set against a dramatic mountain range at sunset. The foreground and midground are filled with vibrant colorful spirals, concentric circles, and glowing cyan, pink, and orange orbs in a hypnotic pattern.
